# ORACLE BRIEF — April 12, 2026

Bitcoin's sitting at $71,182, down a fraction on the day. Extreme Fear reading—12 on the index—tells you retail's spooked, but here's what matters: network fundamentals stay solid. Hashrate holding steady at 1,068 EH/s, no capitulation signals from miners.

The mempool's clearing efficiently—28,737 transactions backed up, but fees collapsed to 1 sat per byte. Translation: no congestion stress. Block 944,818 confirms we're cruising through the 2026 cycle normally.
